Tip.Text: There is an Action Mode and a GUI mode. While in action mode, player input controls the character. While in GUI mode, player input controls the user interface. To switch between GUI and Action modes, press the ESC key.
You need to aim correctly at the ground or sea to spawn mount or ship figurines.
Always bring a skinning knife with you to skin monster gravestones for skinning materials.
Bows require arrows as ammunition, while Primalist skills require Spirit Beads and Elementalist skills require Dust of the Elements. Ultimate skills also require the appropriate Rune.

Agon is divided into Areas of Influence - capturing each controlling village, hamlet, city or Sea Fortress adds each area to the owning clan. Connecting Areas of Influence connects the various bonuses applied to the clan.

Clans can purchase Asset Protection for a holding they own - Asset Protection cost varies depending on the cost of the buildings in the city and makes the selected city's building impervious to damage for the duration.
If an attacking clan wins a Siege, the invading City is afforded with a 48-hour siege protection buff.
Aventurine employees will NEVER ask for your password! There is absolutely never a reason for you to give it out to anybody!

Bank often! A nice backpack full of loot is the easiest way to tempt your fellow players. After all, if you're lying dead after accidentally falling on their blade 20 times, you don't need all that gear...
Be wary when picking your groups...full loot can make even the closest ally accidentally stab you in the back a dozen times.
Bind your weapons, mounts, potions and food in quickslots for faster use.
You can have two bind spots at any one time - one at a player housing location and another at a city or hamlet.
To capture a City under Siege, the attacking clan must destroy the bindstone of the City or Hamlet.
You can block someone by right-clicking their name in chat.
Use a shield to block incoming damage.
You can board a ship if it has lowered it's fishing nets by climbing on them - when you are captain of a ship you can raise and lower your nets by pressing 'Spacebar'.

Broken weapons and armor are salvageable - they can be salvaged to produce a portion of the raw materials invested originally in crafting them. Normal weapons and armors can also be salvaged for materials, depending on their durability.
City buildings stop functioning when damaged to a certain extent.

Buildings require building modules in order to be constructed - in a similar fashion ships require ship modules. Higher rank ships require higher level ship modules, for example, Veilron ship modules.
You can change camera view by pressing the 'G' key by default.
You can deploy a Camp Fire to cook while on the road and not near an Oven!
Any of your charging abilities can be cancelled by pressing the 'R' key once.
Press the 'R' key to cancel charging a skill.
Cannons cause impact damage - there are towers in Cities with cannon emplacements, ship cannons, and deployable cannons, all with different levels of damage.
Every capital has a sewer dungeon with great starting loot!

Catapults can launch other players in addition to the usual Crackshot and Boomshot ammunition. When firing a catapult, Crackshot does more Impact damage, while Boomshot does an extra amount of Fire damage.
You can only create one character per server, per game account.
Remember to check your radial wheel setup whenever you change your roles.
A Church at Level One provides the owning clan with a +1 bonus to all protections to clan members while inside the City walls.
Certain City buildings provide the owning clan with specific bonuses.
City buildings can be damaged and even destroyed as long as the the owning clan has not enabled Asset Protection for the City.
Crafting in Player Holdings provides you with bonuses that are unavailable elsewhere - you can craft cheaper items that have a chance at being more durable.
City gate, bindstone and workstation permissions are very important - they control who can essentially live in a city.
When a Clan disbands, the Clan holding becomes vulnerable to capture and the only structure removed is the bank.
Clan markets can be used to buy and sell items between holdings owned by the same clan.
Clans can assign various rights to members, allies and even enemies.
Clan vault permissions are very important - anyone with access to the clan vault may access it so watch out for spies!
You can contact Support by placing a ticket via http://cs.darkfallonline.com
Press and hold 'F' on a targeted object to bring up its context menu - taping 'F' will perform the default action for that object.
There are many types of workstations for each crafting category: The Workbench, The Smithy, The Laboratory, The Oven, The Foundry, The Shipyard.
Your crafting skill goes up with usage - the more items you craft using a particular crafting skill, the more your skill increases.

New crafting stations in houses replace any previously placed stations and the previous station is consumed in the process. This does not include Slot Machines, which can be upgraded from Silver to Gold.
You can perform daily and weekly feats in addition to the normal feats to keep gaining prowess.
Damaging a building below 25-percent of its health will cause the building to cease functioning properly until it is repaired.
The more dangerous the area the more profitable harvesting is.
If a defending clan wins a Siege by destroying the Siege Stones before the vulnerability phase, the defending City is afforded with a 24-hour protection buff.
If a defending clan wins a Siege by destroying the Siege Stones after the vulnerability phase, the defending City is afforded with a 12-hour protection buff.
While under Siege, a defending clan can destroy the Siege Stones placed by the attackers and end the Siege.
You can destroy items by dragging and dropping them outside your inventory.
Deployable cannons can be used against City walls, players, and even monsters! Make sure you always have enough black powder ammunition.
You can deploy a strongbox to keep your loot relatively safe for two hours.
There are personal, party and siege strongboxes that can be deployed to accommodate both single players and parties.
Ships have different speeds and acceleration rates, as well as number of cannons that can be used. Health and maximum simultaneous repairs also vary.
To uncover a treasure map, double-click it and watch the minimap area - once the flashing green turns solid green, start digging by using a shovel!
You can enable displaying the Ping/FPS stats from within the Options menu.
Double-click on items instead of dragging and dropping to loot faster.
The D.U.E.L. item can be purchased from the Selentine Shop and traded in game - upon usage, it confers thirty days of subscription time to the game account of the character that used it.
Weapons and armor have the durability attribute. Durability is reduced with usage and once it reaches zero, the item is destroyed.
An empty gravestone is dark - it can only be skinned.
Some monsters may become enraged and gain a limited duration buff.
Equip a shield alongside your one-hand weapon to block incoming damage by pressing the 'V' key.
Feats award prowess points upon completion. There are daily and weekly feats you can do more than once to gain prowess and item rewards.
Select the feats you would like to track from the Feats window - they will be displayed and tracked in your Feat tracker.
You can fish using a simple Fishing Rod, but some of the more rare varieties of fish can only be fished in higher danger zones.
Ships automatically lower their fishing nets when they are critically damaged and can then be boarded.
Consuming food increases your regeneration rate for a limited duration.
Food can be cooked at an oven or camp fire - different recipes require different materials and have different effects.
Against certain monsters, being in a large group will cause them to enter a 'Frenzy' mode - this means once a monster is killed, a new one will spawn in its place.
You can send a friend request to someone by right clicking their name in chat.
Guard towers automatically do damage to enemies unless turned off via the City management window.
Mastery-level ships can only be spawned and despawned in Harbors scattered around Agon. Depending on the actual location, the larger ships might not be spawnable.

Harvest raw materials by using the correct tools on each type of node: Pickaxes on Stone and Metal Veins, Sickles on Herb Laden Shrubberies, Wood Axes on Trees, and Skinners on skinnable monster gravestones.
You can heal your mount by using the Heal Mount skill.
You can ask for a Game Master to help with a support issue by typing /gmhelp in your chat window.
You can hide your helmet from within the Options menu.
A higher crafting skill means less chances of failure - it also enables access to higher level crafting recipes.
Use hotkeys for quickslots and radial wheels for combat efficiency!
Most of the house decorative items, house workstations, and even slot machines drop from Chaos Chests. Other house items, like doors, can be crafted.
Housing can have doors placed to block entry. However, doors can also be destroyed!
When you own a piece of housing, rent is accrued over time. You or a tenant need to pay the rent money within thirteen days, or the housing plot becomes available again to everyone.
You can create a house by creating a deed item, using the engineering skill.
You can create your own house in any available spot of the corresponding size by activating the corresponding deed.
Housing deeds are created using the construction mastery skill.
Ten days after the last payment, the housing for which rent is due becomes available for anyone to place a housing deed of the same size.
The crosshairs and health and timer bars displayed on the HUD are customizable - use the HUD edit mode from the UI sidebar to suit the HUD to your needs and playstyle.

The Immolator buff awards a player that destroys a relic with much increased health, stamina and mana, while making all hits critical. On the downside, Immolators can only receive a miniscule amount of healing and the buff expires on death.
Ingots are used in many recipes and can be crafted at a Smithy using the Smelting skill.
You should take everything in moderation. Except PvP in Darkfall...
Once inside a dungeon you cannot recall or be recalled outside - you will need to either exit the dungeon or die and recall to your bindstone.
You can invite someone to party by right-clicking their name in chat.
Party feats can only be completed while in a party.
Keeping a handy rejuvenation potion in one of your Weapon/Item assignment slots could save you in a sticky situation.
Keys can be used to unlock chests scattered around the world that may contain various rewards, ranging from the mundane to the extravagant.
Leather is a product of rawhides and can be crafted at a Workbench using the Tanning skill.
Levy Collectors fill up with loot that is generated whenever there is activity that drops loot in their area. Levy Collectors require Requisitioning Gauntlets to empty.
Destroying a lighthouse rewards the clan or player that destroyed it with a small percentage of the Sea Fortress' loot.
Press 'F' by default on a gravestone to loot it.
You can add markers on the map for interesting locations.
Some Mastery-level recipes require epic materials that are very rare and difficult to acquire, like Draconian Scale, Fossilized Chitin and Widow Silk.
Some monsters like Menhirs may cause damage to themselves when near death - this does not count as a player kill.
On your minimap you can select recalling to your bindstone or your house if you have bound to a housing spot.
You can mix and match certain armor pieces to have the desired protections and effects on your character.
There are numerous ranks of monsters that represent their difficulty: Varmints, Creeps, Freaks, Beasts, Fiends, Villains, Terrors, Scourges, Monstrosities and Horrors.
The higher the monster rank, the greater their respawn time is. The Kraken for example only appears once per day.
Mounts travel faster on roads but will slow down when damaged.
Your mount is only protected for a few minutes while in a safe area. After that, it's a free for all mount!
To ride higher tier mounts you need to invest Prowess points in your Riding skill.
Death Pigs, Eradans, Garmirs and Tribeland Bears offer different advantages and disadvantages. Higher tier mounts offer greater advantages coupled with increasing costs and disadvantages.

The Nexus is a two-way teleportation device. The same player needs to place a pair of Nexus Entrances to enable them. Any one can access them in either direction. The Entrances can be destroyed and expire after some time.
If server downtime is near to the rent time expiring on a player's housing property, additional grace time is added so that there is ample time to login and pay up.
You can parry if you have a shield equipped by pressing the 'V' key by default.
Pigments can be gathered from monsters and turned into dyes that can be used to dye armor sets. Some colors are very extravagant and some can even be used as camouflage.
You can use the Portals around Agon to fast travel between other Portals for a price.
If you want to farm some potatos you can always use a shovel.
Potions have a variety of beneficial effects on you. They are crafted at a Laboratory, can be used while in combat, and have a specific time duration.
Potions can be used during a fight to recover your stats but have a relatively long cooldown - use them wisely!
Unlike most other potions, potions that offer protection bonuses apply their effect continuously until they expire.
Prowess acquisition does no longer have diminishing returns.
Tier I Prowess Monoliths award 20 prowess points per blast, Tier II 40, and Tier III 50. All Prowess Monoliths remain active for thirty minutes.
Pressing 'Space' when dead will respawn you back at your bindstone. Your possessions, however, will stay behind at your gravestone which anyone will be able to loot!
Prowess monoliths become active when a particular number of a certain monster has been slain.
Prowess monoliths burst with lethal blast damage in between distributing prowess points- you have to check the monolith status on your screen for the next blast or end up an oozing puddle of corpse!
When a prowess monolith is activated, it distributes prowess points to everyone in its immediate vicinity for a specific amount of time.
Prowess points are obtained in any number of ways: crafting, harvesting, killing monsters, completing feats, trawling, scraping, prowess monoliths and more!
Once you have reached the maximum level in a crafting skill, further progress requires purchase of the relevant Mastery skill with Prowess Points.
Higher quality tools yield better results the higher the danger zone level is.

Relics spawn at random all throughout Agon - they can be placed on a Relic Altar inside a Clan Church to provide specific buffs, or can be destroyed at the Altar of Immolation to provide the Immolator buff to the player that destroyed it.
All of your weapon/item assignment slots can have their hotkeys remapped in the key bindings interface.
All of your hotbar abilities can have their hotkeys remapped in the key bindings interface.
You can rename bags by right-clicking on them.
Rent is due three days after a house has been placed or since the last payment. The amount of rent due for housing is increased by 10 gold every hour, until paid.

Repairing requires the usage of repair shards and can used both on buildings and structures as well as ships. You can repair a damaged building or ship by using the Repair tool while having Repair Shards in your backpack.
You can report abuse and gameplay issues to a Game Master by typing /gmreport in your chat window.
Requisitioning requires the use of Requisitioning Gauntlets that consume Globules of Greed. Higher quality gloves consume more globules but requisition the rewards much faster.
The greater the amount of time between requisitions, the greater the amount of rewards from the village.

Once killed and ready to be ganked, you may revive yourself using a revive potion. The Revive Potion only works when you have been killed by monsters, while the Battle Revive Potion only works when another player has killed you.
Right-click on a name in the chat window to access various options.
Right-click on the mini-map to access many different options.
In each role blueprint, you can choose up to eight skills from any school, one ultimate skill and common skills.
Cloth sacks and leather bags are a cheap, efficient way to organize your backpack and bag. It's especially handy for differentiating between different armor sets easily.
Workstations in the safe areas cannot be used for crafting mastery-level recipes.
You can salvage a whole bag by dragging the bag onto the salvaging slot.
Sea Scrappers are used to dredge up salvageable parts from the ocean floor - those broken items become available in the Dredgery Crate.
Use the A-D keys to scroll faster within your inventory.
Sea Fortresses become available for capture when all three surrounding lighthouses are destroyed.
Sea Fortress loot is accrued slowly over time - the more time has passed since it was last captured, the larger the reward when it is captured again.

There are many sea-faring vessels: the Pirate Raft, the Wherry, the Launch, the Coastal Runner, the Sea Scraper, the Fishing Trawler, the Sloop, the Schooner, the Barque, The Brigantine, the Junk, the Frigate and the Ship of the Line.
Various cosmetic and account-related utility items are available from the Selentine Shop, which is easily accessible from within the UI from the Selentine Shop icon.
Clicking on a player name in the chat window lets you send a private message to them.
After declaring a siege by placing the Siege Stones within 800 meters of the holding's bindstone, there is a 22-hour countdown during which the Siege Stones are invulnerable.

A siege must be declared to capture a City or Hamlet - for a Hamlet siege, a clan must have at least 5 members and invest 2000 Dominion points. For a City siege, a Clan must have at least 10 members and invest 5000 dominion points.
Siege Equipment can be used during Sieges to offer advantages to the attacking force: Siege Ladders to scale walls and Catapults to destroy them from a distance.
Siege Equipment can only be crafted at a clan Foundry which is only available in certain cities.
More than one clans can participate in a Siege, either by placing one of the two Siege Stones or by placing a wager with either side.
Clans can purchase Siege Protection for a holding they own - Siege Protection makes declaring a siege for that particular holding impossible while Siege Protection lasts.
Declaring a siege requires the placement of a Siege Stone. Siege Stones are purchased from a Sage - there are Small Siege Stones for sieging Hamlets and Large Siege Stones for sieging Cities.
The Sinspire Dungeon in Banegorge is fairly challenging and cannot be completed by solo characters or small parties. Be wary of entering!
Skills other than Crafting level up by purchasing skill levels using Prowess. Crafting skills go up by crafting items.

Skills are purchased from the appropriate vendor - Battlemasters offer the Battlebrand, Baresark, Slayer, Deadeye, Brawler, and Duelist school skills while Spellmasters offer the Air, Earth, Fire, Water, Chaos, Law, and Life school skills.
Monster graves can be skinned with a skinning knife.
Houses can have Slot Machines that can payout earnings when used. Golden Slot Machines can payout more, but also cost more to play each time.
Spyglasses can be used to scout for nearby ships - the higher the vantage point, the greater their effective range.
Watch your stat bars - you may need to transfer stats to stay alive while fighting by using the Mana to Stamina, Stamina to Health, and Health to Mana Common Skills.
Relics can be stolen unless the owning clan uses Asset Protection to make theft temporarily impossible.
Strongboxes can be destroyed and then can be looted by anyone.
There are personal, party and siege strongboxes that can be deployed to accomodate both single and multiple players.
Structures that have been destroyed need to be rebuilt first - once a building has been destroyed it cannot be repaired.
Supernodes are sources of rare materials - they are more difficult to farm because of the monsters that are usually located thereabouts.
To switch between role templates, you will need to remain out-of-combat for 20 seconds.
You can bundle a sword and shield together on the same quick slot.
Safe zone markets are connected to each other - there is a fee for orders that are not placed in the same market that you are using.

Teleport using Portal Chambers costs gold so be sure to have some with you. Teleport Runes require Teleportation Dust in order to be used. Summon Shards can be used to teleport a friend to your location, by the Summon Friend button in your Social window.
Teleportation Sickness is incurred when using Portal Chambers. It prevents you from teleporting again for a significant amount of time.
Think tactically! Use the terrain and your movement skills to avoid attacks from monsters or other players.
There are three tiers of Prowess Monoliths: Tier I awards prowess to players that have up to 15000 Prowess, while Tier II up to 45000 and Tier III up to 150000 respectively.
Press the 'T' key to toggle between horizontal and vertical attacks - this also toggles between attacking with your mount or your sword while you are riding a mount.
Press the 'Num Lock' key by default toggles auto-running.
Pressing the 'Caps Lock' key by default toggles auto-sprinting.
Fishing Trawlers are the only way to fish certain types of fish that can only be found exclusively in danger zones.
The larger the size of the treasure map, the larger the treasure you might unearth!
You can use a Catapult to launch projectiles as well as other players!

The various types of houses: Cottage, House, Villa, Large Villa, Keep. The Cottage is the smallest one, the Keep is the biggest one. A bigger house has more bindspots, decoration and workstation options.

Once a village is captured or requisitioned, the owning clan can set the time until the next requisition. The requisition timer is shared for all villages the clan owns - i.e. they will become available for requisitioning at the same time.
You can whisper to someone by right-clicking their name in chat.

Upon winning a siege, wagers and reward amounts are distributed among the participants, depending on whether or not any Siege Stones were destroyed, the actual damage against the holding's bindstone, and the number of participants involved.
Most items can be crafted at a workstation.
Once vulnerable, there are 2 hours during which the siege can be won by either side.
When using the helm of a ship inside of a safe zone, no-one else can use it except you for ten minutes.
Boosters can be purchased from inside the Roles window to further extend your character's maximum attribute levels.
